about.text: A semi-soft cheese made in the village of Pría, Llanes council, from pasteurised cow's milk with sheep's cream added. It is set with natural rennet, pressed for 24 hours, brined and cured about two months; the smoked Ahumado de Pría is smoked over oak and beech wood.

sources.text: Milk, process, smoking, appearance, flavour and fat.
